title: Adapt for Planning, Not just Prediction: Optimistic Test-Time World Model Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2610.35636v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Latent world models are typically pre-trained offline and kept frozen at test time, so planning with them can degrade under distribution shift. Test-time adaptation (TTA) can mitigate this degradation by updating the model during deployment. Unlike pre-training on fixed data, TTA for planning is closed-loop: the planner uses model rollouts to select actions, and the resulting transitions drive the next update. This raises the question: which objective should guide TTA for planning? Under a prediction-only objective, the model is fit only to the outcomes of its own actions, so it can remain wrong about the actions that would reach the goal, and low prediction error need not translate into better planning. Inspired by reward-biased maximum likelihood from adaptive control, we introduce Optimistic Test-Time Adaptation (OpTTA). translated_title: 为规划而适应，而非仅为预测：乐观的测试时世界模型自适应
translated_abstract: 潜在世界模型通常在离线阶段预训练，并在测试时保持冻结，因此在分布偏移下使用它们进行规划可能导致性能退化。测试时自适应（TTA）可以通过在部署期间更新模型来缓解这种退化。与在固定数据上进行预训练不同，用于规划的TTA是闭环的：规划器利用模型 rollout 来选择动作，而由此产生的状态转移又驱动下一次模型更新。这就引出一个问题：应当用什么目标来指导用于规划的TTA？在仅以预测为目标的情况下，模型只拟合其自身动作的结果，因此对于哪些动作能够达成目标，模型仍可能判断错误，而且低预测误差未必能转化为更好的规划。受自适应控制中奖励偏置最大似然方法的启发，我们提出了乐观测试时自适应。其目标函数包含两项：观测状态转移上的预测损失，以及规划器在（模型 rollout 上）的目标达成代价。
tldr: 提出乐观测试时自适应方法OpTTA，在传统预测损失之外引入规划器的目标达成代价作为适应目标，使世界模型在分布偏移下为“规划得更好”而自适应，而非仅仅提升预测精度。
en_tdlr: Proposes OpTTA, an optimistic test-time adaptation objective that combines prediction loss with the planner's goal-reaching cost, enabling world models to adapt for better planning under distribution shift rather than merely minimizing prediction error.
